description: Lesson i7: I2C1 bus scan (PB6 SCL / PB7 SDA, 100 kHz) then an AT24C02 (0x50) page write of the inverted old contents with ACK polling and a verified read-back; report on USART1
expect:
72 MHz. I2C1 PB6 (SCL) / PB7 (SDA) AF open-drain, 100 kHz (FREQ 36, CCR 180, TRISE 37); AT24C02 at 0x50 (A2-A0, WP at GND) with 4.7 kOhm pull-ups; USART1 PA9/PA10 115200 8N1. Once after reset: 'I2C1 scan 0x08-0x77
', HAL_I2C_IsDeviceReady (1 trial, 2 ms) on 0x08..0x77 with 'found 0xNN
' per acknowledging device, then 'scan done N
'. Without pull-ups the bus never reads idle: 'bus busy at 0x08: SDA/SCL stuck low (pull-ups?)
scan done 0
' and stop; no device at 0x50: 'eeprom not found at 0x50
' and stop. Else 'before: ' + the 8 bytes at 0x10 in hex (FF on an erased part; the EEPROM is non-volatile, so a second run sees 00 = the complement written by the first) + '
'; the complement of those bytes is written as one page, ACK polling counts the NACKed probes during the 5 ms write cycle: 'wrote 8 bytes at 0x10, ready after P polls
' (P about 45, 0 when WP is high and the write is ignored); the page is read back and compared: 'read 8 bytes ok
eeprom ok
', or 'mismatch at 0xAA: wrote 0xWW read 0xRR
eeprom write failed
'. A HAL failure prints '<step> error: HAL status S, ErrorCode 0xE
'. Then WFI.

circuit: PB6, PB7: AT24C02 (A2-A0, WP to GND) + 4.7k pull-ups to 3V3
USART1: virtual terminal on PA9 (TX) / PA10 (RX)

USART1.match:
^I2C1 scan 0x08-0x77
found 0x50
scan done 1
before: (?:(?:FF ){7}FF|(?:00 ){7}00)
wrote 8 bytes at 0x10, ready after (?:3[5-9]|4[0-9]|50) polls
read 8 bytes ok
eeprom ok
$
